env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Contextual loGo/s words stay ordinary identifiers: the same
# declarations build and run under plain go, under logos for a Go
# module, and under logos for a loGo/s module.
cd go
go run .
stdout '^1 2 3 4 5 6$'
logos run .
stdout '^1 2 3 4 5 6$'
cd ../lgo
logos run .
stdout '^1 2 3 4 5 6$'
cd ..

-- go/go.mod --
module example.com/kwgo

go 1.27

-- go/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	yield := 1
	scope := 2
	group := 3
	option := 4
	comptime := 5
	errdefer := 6
	fmt.Println(yield, scope, group, option, comptime, errdefer)
}

-- lgo/go.mod --
module example.com/kwlgo

go 1.27

-- lgo/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	yield := 1
	scope := 2
	group := 3
	option := 4
	comptime := 5
	errdefer := 6
	fmt.Println(yield, scope, group, option, comptime, errdefer)
}
